name: Cup
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of the cup in various ways, symbolizing both physical and spiritual realities. Cups made of silver and gold appear in historical narratives, such as Joseph's silver cup in Genesis 44:2 and Pharaoh's cup in Genesis 40:11, indicating their value and significance. Figuratively, the cup represents God's judgment and blessing: Psalms 75:8 portrays the Lord holding a cup of red wine as a symbol of divine justice poured out on the wicked, while Psalms 23:5 depicts a cup overflowing as a sign of God's abundant provision and comfort. Additionally, cups convey experiences of sorrow and joy, as seen in Psalms 11:6 and Psalms 73:10, illustrating the fullness of human trials and consolation under God's sovereign care.
